violated_contract: A result page that merges one source's page N with extra hits from an unpaged source may only cut the extras. The next request resumes the paged source at page N+1, so a page-N hit the merged page drops is never returned on any page. Conversation search put spoken-word (transcript chunk) hits ahead of Typesense page 1, filled its candidate cap and cut the page to per_page, so the Typesense hits pushed past the cut were skipped while page 2 started at Typesense page 2.
canonical_prevention: Keep every hit of the paged source's current page on the merged page: extra hits take only the candidate slots the page's own hits leave, and the per_page cut drops extras only. A behavioural test walks two pages with extra hits leading page 1 and asserts every paged-source hit is listed exactly once, including when the extras alone would fill the candidate cap.
